reported.quote: The revenues for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 was INR10,520 crores
EBITDA excluding exceptional gain for the quarter was INR418 crores.
PAT after minority interest and excluding exceptional gain for the quarter was INR192 crores.
Revenues for the year ended March 31, 2026, were INR48,893 crores against INR38,880 crores in the same period last year.
PAT after minority interest, excluding exceptional gain for the year was INR845 crores against INR706 crores in the same period last year, a growth of 20%.
Revenue for the quarter for mobile and other EMS business was INR9,485 crores and operating profit of INR337 crores.
Home appliances, revenue for the quarter was INR329 crores and operating profit was INR31 crores.
supported healthy ROCE and ROE of 44.8% and 28.1%, respectively.

guidance.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat. We feel that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.
We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27. That's another major trigger of growth.
The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores. We expect 2x after we have formed the JV with Signify.
We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.
